title: Live-voice PCM frames are not size-validated; utterance buffering is bounded by frame count, not bytes
current_behavior: Any binary WebSocket frame is forwarded to push_pcm; each frame advances the endpoint clock by config.frame_ms regardless of its byte length, so an authenticated client can buffer up to ~750 oversized frames per utterance before they are wrapped as WAV and sent to Whisper. The VAD also iterates every sample of each frame on the event loop. No per-frame or per-utterance byte cap exists.
expected_behavior: Frames larger than EnergyVad.frame_bytes are rejected or split; the utterance buffer is capped in bytes (max_utterance_ms * sample_rate * 2).
recommendation: Validate len(frame) in voice_live.py before push_pcm (close 4400 on violation), add a byte ceiling in LiveVoiceSession.push_pcm, and add a unit test with an oversized frame.

title: No end-to-end evidence that batch or live speech works on any built image; the load proof is a stub and CI never runs an engine-backed test
current_behavior: Every real-engine test is skipif-gated on binaries that the CI job never installs; the live round-trip load test unconditionally skips; no Phase H device or latency report exists; BACKEND_STATUS.md:70 records Voice as BUILT.
expected_behavior: CI installs espeak-ng/tesseract-ocr so the skipped tests run, or a container job runs them; the load round trip is implemented and a report committed before Phase H / M12 advances.
recommendation: Add the two apt packages to the backend CI job; implement test_live_voice_roundtrip.py (Piper -> Whisper) against the built image and commit the report.

title: Image understanding is implemented but unreachable in every known deployment: no provider declares the image modality, vision is off, and no VLM evidence exists
evidence: git ls-files docs/reports (no phase-6-vision or vision-eval report)
current_behavior: VisionEngine exists and is tested only with the echo provider. In production the client hides the attach button and API callers get 503 dependency_unavailable. Enabling AURA_VISION_ENABLED without an image-capable provider makes every image turn OCR-only (flagged degraded).
expected_behavior: A pinned VLM serving the vision pool with a committed phase-6-vision report and a vision-eval run (ADR-031 exit).
recommendation: Keep GAP-019 at in_progress/built_not_proven; do not describe vision as a product capability until deploy/scripts/verify_vision.py has produced a report. Blocked on GAP-012.

title: Whisper model weights are fetched from the Hugging Face Hub at first transcription, with no revision pin and no bake into the image
current_behavior: The first /voice/transcribe or live turn on each fresh container (per gateway worker) downloads tiny.en (~75 MB) over the network; Hub outages or rate limits surface as DependencyUnavailableError on the user's first voice note; the revision is unpinned. Readiness reports stt as configured before any weights exist on disk.
expected_behavior: Weights downloaded and SHA-pinned at image build like the Piper voices, or loaded at startup, with a recorded revision (CB-18 / GAP-031).
recommendation: Add a Dockerfile step pulling the CTranslate2 tiny.en snapshot into HF_HOME with a checksum, or warm the model in lifespan startup and document the runtime dependency.

title: Arabic is asymmetric across the pipeline: Arabic TTS ships, but STT is English-only and OCR has no Arabic language data
current_behavior: An Arabic voice note transcribes as English garbage or empty; the live page rejects language 'ar' at start; the image installs only tesseract-ocr (eng+osd), so AURA_KNOWLEDGE_OCR_LANG=ara would make every OCR call fail inside apply_ocr, leaving pages unreadable with no startup error.
expected_behavior: A multilingual Whisper size with measured WER, and tesseract-ocr-ara installed when Arabic OCR is configured (or a startup check that the configured ocr_lang is installed).
recommendation: Install tesseract-ocr-ara in the Dockerfile; validate ocr_lang against pytesseract.get_languages() at container build; schedule the GAP-020 WER report.

title: Live-voice language from the client start frame is passed unvalidated to Whisper
current_behavior: With a multilingual model configured, an arbitrary string reaches WhisperModel.transcribe(language=...); the exception is reported as stt_failed with only the exception type name.
expected_behavior: An allow-list of ISO 639-1 codes; language_unsupported for others.
recommendation: Validate the language at start-frame handling in voice_live.py.

title: Enabling vision on a deployment without a VLM silently turns every image turn into OCR-only answers
current_behavior: GET /capabilities advertises images as available whenever OCR exists; the client shows the attach button; answers are grounded only in OCR text (flagged degraded, mode=ocr_fallback).
expected_behavior: available distinguishes 'a vision model can serve' from 'only OCR can'; the client shows a reduced affordance.
recommendation: Add a mode field (vlm/ocr_only) to the capabilities payload and gate the attach UI copy on it.

title: espeak-ng receives the spoken text as a positional argv element without a '--' separator
current_behavior: create_subprocess_exec is used, so no shell injection; a prepared text beginning with '-' may be parsed as an option by espeak-ng and fail (non-zero exit -> RuntimeError -> tts_failed/500) rather than be spoken. Whether prepare_spoken_text strips a leading dash was not verified.
expected_behavior: Text passed after '--' or via stdin.
recommendation: Insert '--' before the text in build_espeak_command and add a test with '-hello'.

title: Documentation inaccuracies around multimodal status
current_behavior: Stale 'vision: not implemented' and 'no OCR' claims remain in the prior review and gap register; GAP-019 contradicts its own later entry; two docstrings describe adapters that no longer match the wiring.
recommendation: Mark the Full System Review section superseded, close the agentic.py item of GAP-039/CB-31, collapse GAP-019's reverified_2026_10_30 note, and refresh the two docstrings.
